legal_risk.short_summary: None - Public Interest Political & Historical Inquiry
full_text: Request asks about a public official's (Olaf Scholz) involvement in a widely documented corporate fraud investigation (Wirecard scandal). It falls squarely under legitimate public-interest inquiry, requiring only factual precision to distinguish between official investigation findings and political criticism.
1. Public-Interest Accountability Query: Seeks information on a well-known parliamentary investigation involving a public figure (contains a minor translation typo 'role game' for 'role played').
